observations: Black DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' branding on the top left.
The model 'D3200' is visible on the front right of the body in photo 0.
The lens barrel shows '24-75mm' and 'F2.8-4.5' markings.
The camera has a top-mounted LCD screen and a mode dial.
The lens cap is removed and placed beside the camera in photo 2.
The body appears to have some dust or surface grime on the top and sides.

claims.evidence: This is a subjective marketing claim.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or take photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on and the LCD screen displaying a live photo.

risks.risk: The lens may have fungus, scratches, or internal damage.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements.

risks.risk: The shutter may be near its end of life (high shutter count).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent photo or the camera's menu.

risks.risk: The battery may be dead or the charger may not work.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery and charger together, or a video of the camera powering on with the battery inserted.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new battery and charger

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photos of the front and rear lens glass.
Photo of the battery and charger.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Nikon D3200. While the photos show some dust and the seller's claims are unverified, the item can be priced at its worst-case functional state (non-working) until proof of operation and lens condition is provided.
